In rho_3 the cone label Theta'' and delta''_2 likewise carry two primes. The adjacent single-prime definition Delta_(d',empty)=Delta' distinguishes the shapes. rows.note: L1169.R1: The row's classification as a decided misreading is contradicted by the ink and even by its supplied remark that the transcription is faithful. The double-prime notation is written throughout the cited rho stages. Preserve it. The proposed use of Delta', delta' on the projective side is an authorial convention correction, not an optical correction. No proof of the construction or duality has been performed.
